newsitem.title: UK: Von der Heyden to be PepsiCo CFO - Cadbury.
newsitem.headline: Von der Heyden to be PepsiCo CFO - Cadbury.

text.p: Cadbury Schweppes Plc said on Wednesday it had accepted the resignation of Karl von der Heyden from its board, adding that he had been appointed vice chairman and chief financial officer of PepsiCo Inc.

"In his short time with Cadbury Schweppes Karl von der Heyden has made a valuable contribution to the company. While we are disappointed that he has resigned from the board, we understand his wish to take up this challenging new appointment," chairman Dominic Cadbury said in a statement.
Von der Heyden, a non-executive director, joined the Cadbury Schweppes board on March 5. His resignation is effective September 18, Cadbury Schweppes said.
